scope: Read-only review of new quick_connect_selection.py WIP; no source edit or execution of that module, no provider/auth reads.
positive_controls_observed: Unknown harness token does not silently select the only observed family
Freshness is checked before absence/configuration; stale is not absence
Explicit candidate_ref filters exact installation; multiple candidates require choice
Choice preparation uses canonical GETs and does not reserve/Test/Finish
Public bound ID can resume without probing a new installation

findings_sent_to_source_owner.recommendation: Reject the contradictory new-agent intent before existing-ID resume, or prove caller enforces the same fence.

findings_sent_to_source_owner.observation: In the reviewed WIP, new_connection=true plus explicit agent/binding and a free ID could reach legacy associate.
findings_sent_to_source_owner.recommendation: Explicit addition must not silently become legacy association; require corrected command/intent.

findings_sent_to_source_owner.observation: Retained Quick Connect early return compared only ID, project label, client and new_agent in this module.
findings_sent_to_source_owner.recommendation: Before retained return/apply, caller or helper must prove all exact agent/binding/workspace/candidate/provider/root/topology selectors and original Server; do not infer that absence of Git lookup is sufficient recovery validation.

findings_sent_to_source_owner.observation: Legacy association selection carries args.client; canonical binding authority is revalidated in downstream flow.
findings_sent_to_source_owner.recommendation: Prove downstream metadata association checks actual adapter/full exact reference before any metadata write; requested family is not identity proof.

findings_sent_to_source_owner.observation: prepare selects embedded local_executor and resolves supplied root before public-ID choice.
findings_sent_to_source_owner.recommendation: Caller must preserve remote-specific path/topology semantics; operator-local CWD must not become Connector execution root. This local helper alone does not qualify QC027.

limits: Review records a specific WIP read, not final source qualification. Findings may be resolved by subsequent source-owner edits or caller fences; require focused integration tests against that later cut. No PASS for remote, recovery or real authority is implied.
